title: Cap the doubling-payoff game
hook: Two stated cases: explore the distinction between capped expectation and typical payout.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the distinction between capped expectation and typical payout affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Expected, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the distinction between capped expectation and typical payout in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.

claims.text: Every allowed first-head round contributes one unit to expectation. Extending the cap increases expectation without making a typical payoff grow the same way. This comparison isolates the distinction between capped expectation and typical payout.
